title: Two dry years
creator: Electrify examples
description: Prepare the Lusaka grid for two dry years. Each company can pay for conservation or accept emergency fuel funding each year, while keeping supply reliable and emissions within budget.

items.label: Supply customers through both dry years
Keep the drought response below one million tonnes

events.title: First dry year
events.preview: Hydro inflow will fall to 50% for twelve months.
events.endMessage: The second dry year begins with lower inflow.

events.title: Second dry year
events.preview: Hydro inflow will fall to 25% for twelve months.
events.endMessage: The drought inflow limits have ended.

events.title: First-year conservation
events.preview: Funded conservation will reduce demand 10% for twelve months.

events.title: Second-year conservation
events.preview: Funded conservation will reduce demand 10% for twelve months.

choices.title: Plan the first dry year
choices.prompt: Pay for a year of customer conservation or accept emergency fuel funding for your grid.

options.label: Fund conservation
options.description: Pay 5,000,000 starting-year dollars and 125,000 per month to reduce customer demand 10% for twelve months.
options.message: Your company funded one year of conservation.

options.label: Accept fuel support
options.description: Receive 5,000,000 starting-year dollars; demand remains unchanged.
options.message: Your company accepted emergency fuel funding.

choices.title: Respond to the second dry year
choices.prompt: Pay for a year of customer conservation or accept emergency fuel funding for your grid.

options.label: Fund conservation
options.description: Pay 3,000,000 starting-year dollars and 125,000 per month to reduce customer demand 10% for twelve months.
options.message: Your company funded one year of conservation.

options.label: Accept fuel support
options.description: Receive 3,000,000 starting-year dollars; demand remains unchanged.
options.message: Your company accepted emergency fuel funding.
